deviations.claim_in_article: “A call seemed to come from an AI agent. But as the conversation went on, the voice was not AI at all. It was a person. Meta had run a test that caused exactly this surprise.”
deviations.issue: The Ledger confirms that trained human contractors handled some Muse calls in a test, but it does not establish that a particular call appeared to be AI, that this was discovered during the conversation, or that anyone experienced this as a surprise. The article turns a hypothetical impression in the Japanese source into a specific event.
deviations.explanation: The definite, specific call-and-reveal scenario is not established by the Ledger. This adds an unsupported event and presents the source’s hypothetical user impression as an actual one; the central reveal may therefore mislead readers about what was reported.
